chunks: 3082 - And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"So mention the Name of Allah upon them while they are lined up [for sacrifice]."
He عليه السلام said: "That is when it is lined up for slaughter, and its forelegs are tied from the hoof to the knee, and the falling of its sides is when it falls to the ground."

key_terms.الرُّكْبَةِ: the knee joint of the animal
key_terms.النَّحْرِ: the manner of slaughtering by piercing the throat area of the sacrificial animal
key_terms.جُنُوبِهَا: its sides or flanks, falling to the ground after slaughter
key_terms.صَوَافَّ: lined up and positioned for sacrifice
key_terms.وَقَعَتْ: it fell down to the ground

ai.seo_question: What does the Qur'anic phrase "فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَافَّ" mean in the context of sacrificial animals?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of the Qur'anic phrase about sacrificial animals being "lined up" by describing their physical positioning at the time of nahr. It clarifies a practical ruling and ritual procedure connected to sacrifice, showing how the Imam عليه السلام interprets the verse through its concrete legal application.
